thesis: Markets were closed today for Thanksgiving, so prices are Wednesday's Nov 25 close. thesis: Markets were closed today for Thanksgiving, so prices are Wednesday's Nov 25 close. Amentum edged up about 0.3% to $24.88 (from $24.80) on 2.3x volume, holding the ~20% jump from the pre-report $20.65 after its fiscal Q4 2026 release (8-K dated Nov 23): adjusted EPS of $0.71 beat the $0.66 estimate, full-year adjusted EPS rose 13% to $2.51, backlog was $48.3B with book-to-bill of 1.0x for the quarter and 1.1x for the year, and the board authorized a first-ever $500M buyback (approved Nov 22 per the 10-K), with about half targeted for fiscal 2027. Counter-case: Q4 revenue of $3.62B fell 8% and missed the ~$3.7B consensus, and full-year revenue fell 4% to $13.8B. The company attributes the Q4 drop mainly to an extra week in the prior-year quarter, and book-to-bill of at least 1.0x suggests the backlog isn't shrinking, but neither shows the full-year decline reversing. The buyback and the EPS beat support the read, while the revenue trend stays unresolved. The litigation check found no lawsuit, investigation or restatement. Medium.
invalidation: Revenue keeps declining in the next report, book-to-bill drops below 1.0x, or the shares close back below the pre-report level (~$20.65).
sources: Investing.com (surges on earnings beat and buyback): https://in.investing.com/news/earnings/amentum-surges-on-earnings-beat-and-buyback-program-5722075

thesis: Markets were closed today for Thanksgiving, so prices are Wednesday's Nov 25 close. BIP Inc. fell about 2.1% to $44.56 (from $45.52), 6.3% below its 52-week high, in the first days of trading after the Nov 19 simplification combined Brookfield Infrastructure Partners and Brookfield Infrastructure Corp into one corporation, with holders receiving one BIP Inc. The Nov 6 Q3 release reported FFO of $0.91 per unit, a third straight quarter at the 10% growth target, with data-segment FFO up 25%, while net income fell to $69M from $440M on prior-year asset-sale gains; no Q4 distribution has been declared yet, as BIP Inc. intends to declare it after closing. The litigation check found Brookfield's pending ICSID arbitration against Peru over Lima toll roads and Lima's U.S. discovery dispute, which mainly involve Brookfield's asset-management arm, with no scheduled ruling found, and no restatement. Low; avoid.
invalidation: A company-disclosed result, distribution or asset sale drives the shares after trading under the new structure settles.

thesis: Markets were closed today for Thanksgiving, so prices are Wednesday's Nov 25 close. This run found the approval only in medical-trade coverage, not the company's or FDA's own release. A confirmed approval with an open safety question and a pending PDUFA keeps this medium. The dilution check found an August 2026 8-K on an at-the-market program (outside the ~90-day window) and Nov 2025 stock and convertible offerings; no lawsuit, investigation or restatement was found.
invalidation: The Dec 30 NonAdvSM decision is negative or carries a restrictive label, the GIST launch stalls, or the shares close back below the pre-approval level (~$28).
